import struct

elf[4] = 1  # 32-bit
elf[5] = 1  # little-endian
elf[6] = 1  # ELF version
elf[16:18] = struct.pack('<H', 2)  # ET_EXEC
elf[18:20] = struct.pack('<H', 3)  # EM_386
elf[24:28] = struct.pack('<I', 1)  # entry point
elf[28:32] = struct.pack('<I', 52)  # program header offset
with open('/workspace/afl_input/seed_elf32', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(elf)
print('seed_elf32 created')
"

# Create a minimal valid ELF64 file
python3 -c "
import struct
elf = bytearray(120)
elf[0:4] = b'\x7fELF'
elf[4] = 2  # 64-bit
elf[5] = 1  # little-endian
elf[6] = 1  # ELF version
elf[16:18] = struct.pack('<H', 2)  # ET_EXEC
elf[18:20] = struct.pack('<H', 0x3e)  # EM_X86_64
elf[24:32] = struct.pack('<Q', 1)  # entry point
with open('/workspace/afl_input/seed_elf64', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(elf)
print('seed_elf64 created')
"

pe = bytearray(256)
pe[0:2] = b'MZ'
pe[60:64] = b'\x80\x00\x00\x00'  # e_lfanew

"

# Create an empty file

ls -la /workspace/afl_input/"}
